shared_elements: horizontal band or register of repeated marks
justification: The clearest shared content is a schematic anthropomorphic or torso-like upright form bearing incised/relief decoration, including circular motifs and a horizontal band of repeated marks. The main difference is that A is dominated by a single large human-like body with curvilinear discs and bands, while B is dominated by a crowded register of profile animals and signs arranged across a flat pillar face.
